records.source_text: Acme AI raises $12.5M Series A to expand London engineering hub London-based Acme AI, founded by Jane Doe and Tom Reyes in 2023, announced on Tuesday that Acme AI raised $12.5 million in Series A funding led by Northloop Ventures. We will double our engineering team in London this year, said founder Jane Doe. The company lists 4 open engineering roles on its careers page, including two backend engineers. Acme AI builds evaluation tooling for language models. More at https://acme-ai.example.com.
records.source_title: Acme AI raises $12.5M Series A — TechNews Daily

records.source_text: Nova Labs closes £8M seed round, hiring across London Nova Labs, a London machine-learning infrastructure startup founded by Amir Khan, has closed an £8M seed round. The round was led by Seedline Capital with participation from angels. Founder Amir Khan said the funding will support hiring: Nova Labs currently advertises 7 open roles, five of them engineering positions in London. See https://nova-labs.example.com/careers.
records.source_title: Nova Labs closes £8M seed round — TechNews Daily
